newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Soros raises stake in El-Rov to 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Soros raises stake in El-Rov to 16 pct.

text.p: Emerging Dolphin, a fund controlled by U.S. investor George Soros, raised its stake in El-Rov (Israel) Ltd by 0.8 percent, bringing Soros' total holdings to 16 percent, El-Rov said on Sunday.
El-Rov said the 100,000 shares were acquired outside the bourse on March 16 at 22 shekels each for a total of 2.2 million shekels.
At the same time, Quantum Industrial Holdings, another Soros fund, had also purchased 100,000 shares of El-Rov. The two funds each hold 8.0 percent in the property development and management concern.
Both funds became major shareholders under Israeli regulations last December when their individual holdings began to exceed five percent.
Soros is the second-largest shareholder in El-Rov after Israeli businessman Alfred Akirov, who holds some 70 percent of the shares.
The two Soros funds also hold 1.3 percent in Elkanit Development Ltd, a subsidiary of El-Rov.
